newsitem.title: USA: Neose Technologies files for share offer.
newsitem.headline: Neose Technologies files for share offer.

text.p: Neose Technologies Inc said Monday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for selling 1.25 million new common shares to selected institutional investors.
Net proceeds will be used for research and development, capital expenditures, working capital and general purposes, including possible acquisitions, the company said.

Neose develops and makes complex carbohydrates for a range of healthcare applications, including the development of nutritional additives and pharmaceuticals to treat infectious diseases such as gastritis, peptic ulcers and pediatric ear infections.
